**MARKOV TRACES ON DEGENERATE CYCLOTOMIC HECKE ALGEBRAS DEKE ZHAO Dedicated to Professor Yingbo Zhang on the occasion of her 80th birthday**

16 pp, 8 sections.

**Abstract.** LetH n(u) be the degenerate cyclotomic Hecke algebra with parameteru={u 1, . . . , um}. The paper aims to define and construct the (non-)normalized Markov traces on the sequence{Hn(u)}∞ n=1. This allows us to provide the Brou´ e–Malle–Michel symmetrizing trace onH n(u) and show that the Brundan–Kleshchev trace is a specialization of the non-normalized Markov traces onH n(u). 1.Introduction Letm,nbe positive integers and letW m,n be the complex reflection group of typeG(m,1,n) in Shephard–Todd’s classification [22]. It is well-known thatW m,n is isomorphic to the wreath product (Z/mZ)n ⋊Sn, whereS n is the symmetric group of degreen(generated by the simple transpositions si = (i,i+ 1) fori= 1,...,n−1). Letu={u 1,...,u m}be a set of indeterminates and letC(u) be the fraction field ofC[u].

**Outline.** 1 Introduction; 2 Inductive basis; 3 Normalized Markov traces; 4 Non-normalized Markov traces; 5 Specializations; Acknowledgements; Declaration; References
